name: DO NOT show / let your {recipient} see this
status: PROVEN on wearable gifts (FB). Externally proven on decor when paired with a store reaction or a kids recipient; Omar overruled the old decor ban (omar_decisions #1).
summary: A forbidden-secret line naming the gift RECIPIENT, held over a first frame where the product is big and legible (≥30% of frame), followed by the standard 5-shot try-on/activation body. The line casts the viewer as the buyer hiding a gift; the footage carries the views.
why: Second-biggest family on HeatedJammies: 2.7M, 183K, 165K, 112K, 98K, 97K, 88K, all fresh posts (hooks REPORT §4 G2/G3; PLAYBOOK §1.1).

Biggest external confirmation in the whole dataset: thecozygrump.us 'DO NOT show this to your mom😱😂' on a heated Grinch robe, 12.4M plays / 141.3K shares, posted the same week as our 2.7M; same hook re-rendered 1.2M; merry.made2 1.4M (external REPORT §2).

Framing, not wording, decides it: same text 'DO NOT let your mom see this ❄️😳' got 2.7M with the loaf at 35% of frame vs 16K with a full-body woman and the loaf at 15% (hooks REPORT §1.3, natural_experiments.csv).
Recipient word is required but not sufficient: 'DONT show this to a Christmas MOM' over a Times Square tree with no product at 0 s got 4.2K (PLAYBOOK §1.1).

product_fit.fit: EXPERIMENT ONLY (max 1 test per decor product per week; never the default decor hook)
product_fit.evidence: MerryFire fire pit went 0 for 3 on FB: Merry Glows 'Don't show this to your mom..😳❄️' 3.0K, MerryFires 'DON'T show this to a Christmas-aholic 😳🎄' 3.1K and the same line 33 views (also IG 9.0K; Merry Glow 457). External support is real but not ours: zombie.crawler 3.2M (KIDS), spidey.glow 576K, merryglow.official 198K, tryglowmas 169K/159K. Test only with a legible product at 0 s plus a kids/mom recipient; decor default = then-vs-now or 321-prop-reveal
Purrventure 'Don't show this to a cat mom 😱' had 3 views on a 3-view page (no signal); ext thecozybts shows niche recipients work (417K)
IG 'Don't show this to a skier' 3.3K / 2.7K, 'ski dad' 1.1K

timing.basis: Hook = winner median 3.5 s (2.7M 3.8, 183K 3.5, 97K 3.47, 88K 3.9, 112K 2.87, 98K 2.67). Body = wearable master (body REPORT §1A). Activation (PLUG) at ~66%, payoff at ~84%.

shots.content: product held big at chest / on a tray / boxed, ≥30% of frame at 0.0 s; ONE visible change by 2.0 s (lift, unfold, flip on 'three', box handed over)
shots.camera: calm handheld or locked; slight push-in

shots.content: talent slips the {product} on, turned away with her back to the phone, hood up so the hood design is what the phone sees
open it wide: white sherpa lining, step into the foot pouch (legs view); the B1→B2 boundary is the jump cut
macro: USB / power-bank clicks into the port in the fur
shots.text: JK flip lands exactly here on store hooks

shots.content: POV thumb presses the controller, LED heat levels climb
reclined on couch/bed, fully inside, hood up, eyes close / smile, tree lights behind; CUT MID-ACTION

measured: External: thecozygrump 12.4M first cut 4.80 s, END 13.37 (XA); merry.made2 1.4M first cut 4.30, END 15.23.
rules: Hook block 2.7-3.9 s; external robe winners hold up to 4.8 s, so never cut the hook before 2.6 s (winner first-cut median 3.3 s for wearables, hooks REPORT §1.7).
Activation by 66% ±5% and no body shot >2.2 s before activation except FEAT with a jump cut (body REPORT §3 edit rules).
Payoff starts at 82-88% and lasts ≥1.3 s; hard cut at full music level (78/78 reels, no fades).

text.style: White sentence-case / CAPS-mix CapCut Classic with thin dark outline, centred, text centre 13-20% from top, height ~3% of frame, 1-2 lines, held the whole video (hooks REPORT §3; 63/63 FB reels had text on at 0.0 s).

patterns.pattern: DO NOT let your {mom} see this ❄️😳
DO NOT let your {wife} see this 😳❄️
DO NOT show this to you're {mom} 😳❄️
DO NOT show this to your {mom}😱😂...
DO NOT let your {KIDS} see this..👀🎄
do NOT show this to a {Christmas mom}...😱🎄

rules: Recipient slot order by evidence: mom (2.7M, 112K, 98K, 97K, 88K; ext 12.4M, 1.4M) > grandma (183K) > wife (165K) > kids (ext 3.2M, decor only).
Avoid identity recipients like 'a Christmas-aholic' / 'a Christmas MOM' on our pages: 457, 3.1K, 33, 4.2K. (Confounded with weak openers; test only as an experiment.)
No JK flip, no second card. One line held 0 → end (all 7 HJ winners).
Typos are allowed and may help (112K, 97K; typo coefficient ×4.3, n=6, p=0.10: weak, don't force).
Never 'COMMENT' (omar_decisions #3: FB can flag it as engagement bait; Meta demotes comment-bait, external REPORT §3f).
Keyword = the recipient word from the hook (mirrors snugbaby 488K 'Comment "Mom" if you need one', translated to SAY).
Link captions are not causal (Omar); add the URL only if the page is not under Meta's link cap (external REPORT §6.4).

picks.track: Let It Snow! (Dean Martin) · 0:00 'Oh the weather outside is frightful'
3-2-1 VO 'One, two, three. Let's see how it comes out' + Holly Jolly Christmas (Bublé) from its opening line
picks.start: VO 0-~3.8 s; song at the first body cut

rules: Music at level from frame 0, no designed drop; cuts on action, not beats (body REPORT §6).
Song is not causal alone: the same Last Christmas window ran on HJ flops 16K, 4.6K, 4.2K.

generation_plan.summary: 4 generations: 1 hook at 720p + 3 packed body gens at 720p. One take per gen (D33: auto re-roll only on an absurd failure at >=0.9 confidence, max 1 per shot, logged with reason + cost).

variants.name: Kids-recipient decor
variants.rule: On light-up decor: 'DO NOT let your {grandkids/KIDS} see this..👀🎄' over a POV unpack of the product already half-lit by 2 s.
variants.proof: zombie.crawler 3.2M; 55-64/65+ are the top Insights ages on Merry Glow (PLAYBOOK §2), so grandkids is the buyer's recipient.
variants.gate: 3 renders; kill if all < page median at 72 h, promote if any ≥3× median (external REPORT §5).

variants.name: Store-shelf don't-show
variants.rule: Swap H1 for a shocked shopper pointing at a shelf of the branded boxes; body unchanged.
variants.gate: Same 3-render rule; the shopper must react by 2 s (SHOCK_STORE median is 6.2K without a striking reaction).

variants.name: Niche-tribe recipient
variants.rule: Keep the exact body, change only the recipient to a tribe ('a BTS army', 'a nurse after a 12-hr shift', 'a cat mom') and dress H1's talent for that tribe.
variants.gate: Costs 1 hook gen; run 2 tribes per week max.

review: Is the first frame instantly readable on a phone with the sound off? The spec forces ≥30% product share and a change by 2 s; the 16K flop is the cautionary pair.
Would a top CD reject the body for being the same as everyone's? The body is deliberately constant: identical bodies run 2.2K→6.6M (body REPORT §4), so variance goes into H1 renders.
Fixed: the earlier playbook 'avoid on decor' rule is removed per Omar and replaced with the store-reaction / kids conditions that match the external decor winners.
